column1: # The index examples/figure-marks.qmd prints in a Typst render (M101).
# Derived BY HAND from that source, under the ORACLE RULE at the head of
# tests/run-tests.sh, and never copied from a render. The row shape is the one
# tests/typst-index-main.tsv states.
# The pages come from the source's explicit page breaks: page 1 runs to the
# first break, and each break starts the next page. Each term is one case.
#   alder    a caption mark on a figure with no id, page 1. Pandoc copies the
#            caption into the image's alt text, and the copy files nothing:
#            one locator
#   birch    a caption mark on a figure with an id, page 2: one locator
#   cedar    a range opened in the caption of a figure with no id on page 3,
#            closed in the text on page 4: one range, linked to page 3
#   dogwood  a plain mark in the alt text of an image in a sentence, page 5
#   elder    a principal mark in the same alt text, page 5: one bold locator
#   hazel    a mark in the alt text of an image in a figure div, page 6. The
#            image is not the only content of its paragraph, so it holds no
#            copied caption and its mark files one locator
